mapper.select: SELECT GROUP_CD, GROUP_NM, USE_YN FROM TB_COMM_CODE_GROUP ORDER BY GROUP_CD
SELECT GROUP_CD, CODE, CODE_NM, SORT_ORD, USE_YN FROM TB_COMM_CODE WHERE GROUP_CD = #{groupCd} ORDER BY SORT_ORD, CODE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_COMM_CODE WHERE GROUP_CD = #{groupCd}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_COMM_CODE_GROUP (GROUP_CD, GROUP_NM, USE_YN, REG_ID, REG_DT) VALUES (#{r.groupCd}, #{r.groupNm}, COALESCE(#{r.useYn,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'Y'), #{loginId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)

INSERT INTO TB_COMM_CODE (GROUP_CD, CODE, CODE_NM, SORT_ORD, USE_YN, REG_ID, REG_DT) VALUES (#{r.groupCd}, #{r.code}, #{r.codeNm}, COALESCE(CAST(#{r.sortOrd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS INTEGER), 0), COALESCE(#{r.useYn,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'Y'), #{loginId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM TB_COMM_CODE WHERE GROUP_CD = #{r.groupCd} AND CODE = #{r.code}
